recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量破碎紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔形、三角形與不規則碎片，並有小球形紅血球；視野中血小板極少。在使用 mitomycin 的病人身上，符合藥物相關血栓性微血管病（thrombotic microangiopathy）造成的血小板低下與溶血性貧血。
features: Numerous schistocytes: helmet cells, triangular and irregular fragments scattered throughout
Microspherocytes lacking central pallor among the red cells
Many residual RBCs show central pallor with mild anisocytosis
Markedly decreased platelets in the field
Single small lymphocyte at center; no leukoerythroblastic cells or tumor cells identified
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell fragmentation with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular forms and irregular fragments, accompanied by microspherocytes and mild anisocytosis. Platelets are markedly decreased. A single small lymphocyte is present and no circulating tumor cells or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. In a patient receiving mitomycin, findings are consistent with drug-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia).

ddx.vs: Smear morphology is identical; severe ADAMTS13 deficiency (<10%) distinguishes TTP from drug-associated TMA.
DIC also produces schistocytes but shows prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal in drug-induced TMA.
Metastatic carcinoma-related MAHA often shows leukoerythroblastosis with nucleated RBCs and immature granulocytes, which are not seen here.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT but lacks abundant fragmented cells.
